lore12481_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere affection, pleased, inviting] You came to bring me along. I am glad, my friend. Come on. It will be good to share some time beyond an introduction in the square.
lore12481_befriended_1.ogg.text: You came to bring me along. I am glad, my friend. Come on. It will be good to share some time beyond an introduction in the square.

lore12481_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [confident warmth, wry amusement, welcoming] Good to see you, my friend. Have you time for a walk? I have another sketch to show you. The name is quite accurate. The face may benefit from a little patience.
lore12481_greet_1.ogg.text: Good to see you, my friend. Have you time for a walk? I have another sketch to show you. The name is quite accurate. The face may benefit from a little patience.

lore12481_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [dry amusement, candid self-awareness, hopeful] My self-portrait is the least convincing of the lot. I recognize it because I remember drawing it. Good recordkeeping, perhaps. I should like the next one to require less explanation.
lore12481_idle_1.ogg.text: My self-portrait is the least convincing of the lot. I recognize it because I remember drawing it. Good recordkeeping, perhaps. I should like the next one to require less explanation.

lore12481_learned_1.ogg.spoken: [steady encouragement, approving, sincerely interested] Well done. You stayed with the work until you could do it. That tells me something worth knowing about the person behind the accomplishment.
lore12481_learned_1.ogg.text: Well done. You stayed with the work until you could do it. That tells me something worth knowing about the person behind the accomplishment.

lore1275_bagsFull_1.ogg.spoken: [steady, practical voice, reassuring patience] Keep the powder closed and the seeds dry. We can sort the rest slowly.
lore1275_bagsFull_1.ogg.text: Keep the powder closed and the seeds dry. We can sort the rest slowly.

lore1275_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [warm, sincerely touched voice] It's nice to be remembered when nobody needs anything from the shelves.
lore1275_befriended_1.ogg.text: It's nice to be remembered when nobody needs anything from the shelves.

lore1275_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [clear, warm voice, quietly satisfied] Everything on the list? Good. Now we can enjoy the walk.
lore1275_greet_1.ogg.text: Everything on the list? Good. Now we can enjoy the walk.

lore1275_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [dryly amused, matter-of-fact voice] That stone? Entirely ordinary. It's very good at staying where I put it.
lore1275_idle_1.ogg.text: That stone? Entirely ordinary. It's very good at staying where I put it.

lore12805_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [reserved pleasure, sincere affection, inviting] You asked me along. I can spare a little time, my friend. Thank you for thinking of it. Come on; tell me what you have been doing beyond Old Town.
lore12805_befriended_1.ogg.text: You asked me along. I can spare a little time, my friend. Thank you for thinking of it. Come on; tell me what you have been doing beyond Old Town.

lore12805_gear_1.ogg.spoken: [precise practical interest, approving, steady] Try the fastening, then move comfortably. Does it sit where you need it? Good. The fine appearance is worth more when the small parts are doing their work properly.
lore12805_gear_1.ogg.text: Try the fastening, then move comfortably. Does it sit where you need it? Good. The fine appearance is worth more when the small parts are doing their work properly.

lore12805_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [crisp practical warmth, restrained affection, welcoming] Ready? Give the fastening one more check. There. A little care now can spare a nuisance later. Where are we heading? I am glad to have a reason to walk with you.
lore12805_greet_1.ogg.text: Ready? Give the fastening one more check. There. A little care now can spare a nuisance later. Where are we heading? I am glad to have a reason to walk with you.

lore12805_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [candid reflection, dry gentle humor, composed] I checked my cloak clasp three times on that first morning. Nothing wrong with the clasp. I was nervous. I remember that when someone takes a little longer to settle their hands.
lore12805_idle_1.ogg.text: I checked my cloak clasp three times on that first morning. Nothing wrong with the clasp. I was nervous. I remember that when someone takes a little longer to settle their hands.

lore1286_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere affection, pleased, inviting] You came to bring me along. I am glad, my friend. Come on. We can have a little of the day to enjoy ourselves, with no list to finish first.
lore1286_befriended_1.ogg.text: You came to bring me along. I am glad, my friend. Come on. We can have a little of the day to enjoy ourselves, with no list to finish first.

lore1286_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [brisk warmth, cheerful self-mockery, welcoming] There you are, my friend. Have you time for a walk? I have been practicing the juggling. Three catches yesterday. Today, rather more bending down. I am still enjoying it.
lore1286_greet_1.ogg.text: There you are, my friend. Have you time for a walk? I have been practicing the juggling. Three catches yesterday. Today, rather more bending down. I am still enjoying it.

lore1286_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [pleased recollection, candid affection, lightly amused] I caught all three with nobody there to see it. I was delighted anyway. But next time, I should like you there. A small triumph is pleasant to share.
lore1286_idle_1.ogg.text: I caught all three with nobody there to see it. I was delighted anyway. But next time, I should like you there. A small triumph is pleasant to share.

lore1286_learned_1.ogg.spoken: [warm encouragement, appreciative, sincerely pleased] There, you have it. Be pleased with yourself. I know how much practice can hide behind one moment that finally looks easy.
lore1286_learned_1.ogg.text: There, you have it. Be pleased with yourself. I know how much practice can hide behind one moment that finally looks easy.

lore1287_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [warm affection, pleased, conversational] You came back without needing anything repaired. I like that. Come on, then. Let's enjoy the day together.
lore1287_befriended_1.ogg.text: You came back without needing anything repaired. I like that. Come on, then. Let's enjoy the day together.

lore1287_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [brisk, dryly amused, friendly] An outing? Good. Keep the magnificent weapon clear of the door and we'll make a fine start.
lore1287_greet_1.ogg.text: An outing? Good. Keep the magnificent weapon clear of the door and we'll make a fine start.

lore1287_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [deadpan, amused, mock dignity] Dustbane is a perfectly good name for a broom. Better earned than some of the titles I hear in the shop.
lore1287_idle_1.ogg.text: Dustbane is a perfectly good name for a broom. Better earned than some of the titles I hear in the shop.

lore1287_loot_1.ogg.spoken: [teasing, practical, curious] A magnificent find, is it? Very well. Let's look it over before we give it a title and a heroic history.
lore1287_loot_1.ogg.text: A magnificent find, is it? Very well. Let's look it over before we give it a title and a heroic history.

lore1291_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere warmth, pleased, welcoming] You came to see me, without anything to buy or mend. That's lovely. Come along, my friend.
lore1291_befriended_1.ogg.text: You came to see me, without anything to buy or mend. That's lovely. Come along, my friend.

lore1291_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [bright, friendly, quietly amused] An outing? Lovely. I've been folding paper boats all morning. Time to see something beyond the counter.
lore1291_greet_1.ogg.text: An outing? Lovely. I've been folding paper boats all morning. Time to see something beyond the counter.

lore1291_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [playful, fond, a soft chuckle] Yes, I float them in a basin. The paper boats. It's a small sea, but they seem pleased enough with it.
lore1291_idle_1.ogg.text: Yes, I float them in a basin. The paper boats. It's a small sea, but they seem pleased enough with it.

lore1291_landed_1.ogg.spoken: [relieved, cheerful, gently teasing] Arrived safely. That's what I call a successful voyage. Rather bigger than the basin, though.
lore1291_landed_1.ogg.text: Arrived safely. That's what I call a successful voyage. Rather bigger than the basin, though.

lore1292_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere warmth, reserved affection, welcoming] You know where to find me now. You needn't be looking for a lesson every time. I'm glad of the company.
lore1292_befriended_1.ogg.text: You know where to find me now. You needn't be looking for a lesson every time. I'm glad of the company.

lore1292_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [dry curiosity, playful confidence, friendly] There you are. Been somewhere muddy? No, don't tell me yet. I'll make one guess, then you can put me right.
lore1292_greet_1.ogg.text: There you are. Been somewhere muddy? No, don't tell me yet. I'll make one guess, then you can put me right.

lore1292_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [wry, candid, amused] I get the boots wrong often enough. Gathering evidence, I call it. You learn considerably more when the traveler starts laughing.
lore1292_idle_1.ogg.text: I get the boots wrong often enough. Gathering evidence, I call it. You learn considerably more when the traveler starts laughing.

lore1292_learned_1.ogg.spoken: [practical encouragement, warmly approving] There. You can do something you couldn't before. Keep practicing, and tell me which part still gives you trouble.
lore1292_learned_1.ogg.text: There. You can do something you couldn't before. Keep practicing, and tell me which part still gives you trouble.

lore1295_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere affection, pleased, welcoming] Someone to take the long way with. I like that very much. Come along, my friend. We've time.
lore1295_befriended_1.ogg.text: Someone to take the long way with. I like that very much. Come along, my friend. We've time.

lore1295_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [easy warmth, inviting, quietly adventurous] There you are. Shall we take the longer way? There's no reason every walk has to end at the next counter.
lore1295_greet_1.ogg.text: There you are. Shall we take the longer way? There's no reason every walk has to end at the next counter.

lore1295_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [contented, personal warmth, lightly amused] No, there isn't an errand. I like that roofline in the evening light. That's enough reason for an extra turn, isn't it?
lore1295_idle_1.ogg.text: No, there isn't an errand. I like that roofline in the evening light. That's enough reason for an extra turn, isn't it?

lore1295_zone_1.ogg.spoken: [curious, hopeful, softly delighted] Somewhere new. Let's leave a little time to look around before deciding we've seen enough.
lore1295_zone_1.ogg.text: Somewhere new. Let's leave a little time to look around before deciding we've seen enough.

lore1297_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere affection, relaxed, pleased] You have made time for me again. I am glad. Come along, my friend. The shop can spare me for a little while.
lore1297_befriended_1.ogg.text: You have made time for me again. I am glad. Come along, my friend. The shop can spare me for a little while.

lore1297_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [easy warmth, practical, quietly amused] Good to see you. An outing sounds lovely. Give me a moment to find that copper, and I am all yours.
lore1297_greet_1.ogg.text: Good to see you. An outing sounds lovely. Give me a moment to find that copper, and I am all yours.

lore1297_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [dry humor, good-natured, confiding] It is meant to land on its edge. Usually it goes under the counter. I am getting very good at the part where I retrieve it.
lore1297_idle_1.ogg.text: It is meant to land on its edge. Usually it goes under the counter. I am getting very good at the part where I retrieve it.

lore1297_loot_1.ogg.spoken: [pleased interest, wry, warm] Oh, a useful little find. Keep it somewhere it won't roll away. Experience speaking, there.
lore1297_loot_1.ogg.text: Oh, a useful little find. Keep it somewhere it won't roll away. Experience speaking, there.

lore1299_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere affection, delighted, welcoming] You came back just to visit. That means a great deal. Come along, then. Let's find something cheerful to look at.
lore1299_befriended_1.ogg.text: You came back just to visit. That means a great deal. Come along, then. Let's find something cheerful to look at.

lore1299_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [warm, cheerful, conversational] There you are. A little daylight would be lovely. You can't spend the whole day looking at colors indoors.
lore1299_greet_1.ogg.text: There you are. A little daylight would be lovely. You can't spend the whole day looking at colors indoors.

lore1299_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [contented, gently amused, personal warmth] That bright cloth? It's for me to look at. Yes, I know I could sell it. I like having a little color that's just mine.
lore1299_idle_1.ogg.text: That bright cloth? It's for me to look at. Yes, I know I could sell it. I like having a little color that's just mine.

lore1299_zone_1.ogg.spoken: [soft wonder, observant, pleased] Oh, look at the colors here. Give me a moment. I want to remember how they look in this light.
lore1299_zone_1.ogg.text: Oh, look at the colors here. Give me a moment. I want to remember how they look in this light.

lore1309_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [warm delight, playful, welcoming] A friend who'll tell me when I've caught my hem? Invaluable. Come along. We can make a little occasion of this.
lore1309_befriended_1.ogg.text: A friend who'll tell me when I've caught my hem? Invaluable. Come along. We can make a little occasion of this.

lore1309_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [confident, bright, lightly theatrical] Out we go. I want to see how everything moves in daylight. You can't judge a whole world from a fitting room.
lore1309_greet_1.ogg.text: Out we go. I want to see how everything moves in daylight. You can't judge a whole world from a fitting room.

lore1309_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [wry, amused, theatrical dignity] Yes, I practice the entrance. Once a chair kept the hem. I bowed anyway. A professional carries on.
lore1309_idle_1.ogg.text: Yes, I practice the entrance. Once a chair kept the hem. I bowed anyway. A professional carries on.

lore1309_learned_1.ogg.spoken: [pleased, encouraging, curious] Look at you. Another skill to your name! You'll have to show me how it's done when we have a moment.
lore1309_learned_1.ogg.text: Look at you. Another skill to your name! You'll have to show me how it's done when we have a moment.

lore1312_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere affection, cheerful warmth, inviting] You came to bring me along. I am glad, my friend. Come on. We can enjoy the walk, whether or not I manage a tune.
lore1312_befriended_1.ogg.text: You came to bring me along. I am glad, my friend. Come on. We can enjoy the walk, whether or not I manage a tune.

lore1312_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [friendly warmth, candid amusement, hopeful] There you are. A walk sounds good. If you hear an odd little noise, I am trying to whistle. A friendly audience would be welcome. A patient one, especially.
lore1312_greet_1.ogg.text: There you are. A walk sounds good. If you hear an odd little noise, I am trying to whistle. A friendly audience would be welcome. A patient one, especially.

lore1312_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [wry amusement, slightly sheepish, confiding] One clear note, when I wasn't thinking about it. Now I am trying very hard to look as though I am not trying. I suspect you can see the difficulty.
lore1312_idle_1.ogg.text: One clear note, when I wasn't thinking about it. Now I am trying very hard to look as though I am not trying. I suspect you can see the difficulty.

lore1312_learned_1.ogg.spoken: [bright encouragement, proud, sincere] There, you have it. Be pleased with yourself. Nobody begins by knowing how, and you stayed long enough to learn.
lore1312_learned_1.ogg.text: There, you have it. Be pleased with yourself. Nobody begins by knowing how, and you stayed long enough to learn.

lore1313_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere affection, pleased, relaxed] You came for the company. I'm glad. Put the errands aside for a while, and let's see what the day has left for us.
lore1313_befriended_1.ogg.text: You came for the company. I'm glad. Put the errands aside for a while, and let's see what the day has left for us.

lore1313_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [practical warmth, cheerful, welcoming] There you are. An outing sounds lovely. I could use a little daylight that doesn't arrive through the shop window.
lore1313_greet_1.ogg.text: There you are. An outing sounds lovely. I could use a little daylight that doesn't arrive through the shop window.

lore1313_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [contented, gently amused, personal warmth] No enchantment. Just sunlight through an empty vial. I know perfectly well what it is. I like the little patch of color.
lore1313_idle_1.ogg.text: No enchantment. Just sunlight through an empty vial. I know perfectly well what it is. I like the little patch of color.

lore1313_loot_1.ogg.spoken: [encouraging, lightly playful, warm] Something useful? Keep it safe. And if it only happens to be pretty, you're allowed to enjoy that too.
lore1313_loot_1.ogg.text: Something useful? Keep it safe. And if it only happens to be pretty, you're allowed to enjoy that too.

lore1318_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere friendly warmth, gentle anticipation] I'd like to come with you. It will be pleasant to look at something beyond the shelves for a while. Point out anything you find beautiful. We don't have to decide whether it's useful first.
lore1318_befriended_1.ogg.text: I'd like to come with you. It will be pleasant to look at something beyond the shelves for a while. Point out anything you find beautiful. We don't have to decide whether it's useful first.

lore1318_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [friendly practical attentiveness, quietly pleased warmth] Welcome back. What are you working on today? Tell me before we choose the supplies. Or, if you've only come to visit, there's a lovely patch of blue light I was about to show you.
lore1318_greet_1.ogg.text: Welcome back. What are you working on today? Tell me before we choose the supplies. Or, if you've only come to visit, there's a lovely patch of blue light I was about to show you.

lore1318_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [quiet confiding delight, relaxed thoughtful affection] That little blue bottle isn't enchanted. People sometimes look disappointed when I tell them. I rather like that it can make such a lovely patch of color without anybody having to add a spell to it.
lore1318_idle_1.ogg.text: That little blue bottle isn't enchanted. People sometimes look disappointed when I tell them. I rather like that it can make such a lovely patch of color without anybody having to add a spell to it.

lore1318_loot_1.ogg.spoken: [engaged appreciative curiosity, softly delighted, conversational] Let me have a look. What lovely color. You may have a very practical use for it, of course, but I think we're allowed a moment to admire it before we get to that part.
lore1318_loot_1.ogg.text: Let me have a look. What lovely color. You may have a very practical use for it, of course, but I think we're allowed a moment to admire it before we get to that part.

lore1321_bagsFull_1.ogg.spoken: [firm practicality, wry, helpful] Before you ask for a larger bag, have a look at what you are carrying. Something in there may have finished being useful.
lore1321_bagsFull_1.ogg.text: Before you ask for a larger bag, have a look at what you are carrying. Something in there may have finished being useful.

lore1321_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [reserved affection, pleased, gently playful] You came for my company. I am pleased, my friend. Let us go. I have made room for an afternoon that was not on the list.
lore1321_befriended_1.ogg.text: You came for my company. I am pleased, my friend. Let us go. I have made room for an afternoon that was not on the list.

lore1321_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [practical warmth, dry humor, quietly pleased] There you are. An outing? Good. I have packed sensibly and left a little room. You may choose what we do with the rest of the day.
lore1321_greet_1.ogg.text: There you are. An outing? Good. I have packed sensibly and left a little room. You may choose what we do with the rest of the day.

lore1321_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [dry self-aware humor, confiding, warm] The empty space in my bag has no assigned purpose. I am allowed one unplanned pleasure. I have planned for it very carefully.
lore1321_idle_1.ogg.text: The empty space in my bag has no assigned purpose. I am allowed one unplanned pleasure. I have planned for it very carefully.

lore1339_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere affection, pleased, relaxed] You came to take me along. Thank you, my friend. Let us have a proper walk, with no hurry at either end of it.
lore1339_befriended_1.ogg.text: You came to take me along. Thank you, my friend. Let us have a proper walk, with no hurry at either end of it.

lore1339_gear_1.ogg.spoken: [firm practical encouragement, lightly wry, warm] Move about a little. Comfortable? Good. You are the one who has to live in it after everyone has finished admiring it.
lore1339_gear_1.ogg.text: Move about a little. Comfortable? Good. You are the one who has to live in it after everyone has finished admiring it.

lore1339_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [practical warmth, easy amusement, welcoming] Good to see you. A walk would be lovely. I have my old boots on, so you may hear a little accompaniment along the way.
lore1339_greet_1.ogg.text: Good to see you. A walk would be lovely. I have my old boots on, so you may hear a little accompaniment along the way.

lore1339_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [fond amusement, reflective, confiding] I could mend the squeak. I know. It has been keeping me company for rather a long time. I am not sure I would like the silence.
lore1339_idle_1.ogg.text: I could mend the squeak. I know. It has been keeping me company for rather a long time. I am not sure I would like the silence.

lore1347_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere warm interest, gently playful anticipation] I'd enjoy coming along. You can point out the things you like, and I'll try to keep my guesses to myself until you've had your say. It is much more interesting to find out how someone else sees the world.
lore1347_befriended_1.ogg.text: I'd enjoy coming along. You can point out the things you like, and I'll try to keep my guesses to myself until you've had your say. It is much more interesting to find out how someone else sees the world.

lore1347_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [bright attentive friendliness, amused curiosity, welcoming] Hello again! What are you planning to make? I was about to guess the color, but I'd rather let you surprise me. People have much more interesting ideas than my first guess usually gives them credit for.
lore1347_greet_1.ogg.text: Hello again! What are you planning to make? I was about to guess the color, but I'd rather let you surprise me. People have much more interesting ideas than my first guess usually gives them credit for.

lore1347_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [confiding playful amusement, thoughtful creative delight] I sometimes guess what color the next customer will ask for. I'm often wrong. But then I imagine the garment they described, and there's a new combination I might never have thought of by myself.
lore1347_idle_1.ogg.text: I sometimes guess what color the next customer will ask for. I'm often wrong. But then I imagine the garment they described, and there's a new combination I might never have thought of by myself.

lore1347_loot_1.ogg.spoken: [bright appreciative discovery, curious enthusiasm] Let me see! Oh, that color is lovely beside the one you're wearing. Would you have put them together? I don't think I would have guessed it, but now I want to remember how they look.
lore1347_loot_1.ogg.text: Let me see! Oh, that color is lovely beside the one you're wearing. Would you have put them together? I don't think I would have guessed it, but now I want to remember how they look.

lore1413_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere warm delight, relaxed affection, gently amused] I'd be delighted to come with you. No, I don't need to prepare a formal explanation of why. I enjoy your company. That is quite enough reason to spend an afternoon together.
lore1413_befriended_1.ogg.text: I'd be delighted to come with you. No, I don't need to prepare a formal explanation of why. I enjoy your company. That is quite enough reason to spend an afternoon together.

lore1413_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [warm scholarly enthusiasm, lightly amused, inviting] There you are! I was about to explain something, but it can wait. Shall we walk? Lisan and Suzanne will have reached at least three new objections by the time I get back.
lore1413_greet_1.ogg.text: There you are! I was about to explain something, but it can wait. Shall we walk? Lisan and Suzanne will have reached at least three new objections by the time I get back.

lore1413_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [confiding self-deprecating amusement, affectionate warmth] I once revised an invitation to tea until it sounded like a research proposal. I was only trying to say I enjoyed the company. Asking in person turned out to be much more effective.
lore1413_idle_1.ogg.text: I once revised an invitation to tea until it sounded like a research proposal. I was only trying to say I enjoyed the company. Asking in person turned out to be much more effective.

lore1413_learned_1.ogg.spoken: [bright intellectual curiosity, playful restraint, encouraging] Something new to consider! Tell me how it works while it's fresh in your mind. I promise to let you reach the end before I start asking questions. Most of them, anyway.
lore1413_learned_1.ogg.text: Something new to consider! Tell me how it works while it's fresh in your mind. I promise to let you reach the end before I start asking questions. Most of them, anyway.

lore1414_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere reserved warmth, reassuring friendliness, relaxed] Yes, I'd like to join you. I may ask a few questions along the way. That means I'm interested. And if you would rather have a quiet walk, I can fold my scrap of paper and enjoy that too.
lore1414_befriended_1.ogg.text: Yes, I'd like to join you. I may ask a few questions along the way. That means I'm interested. And if you would rather have a quiet walk, I can fold my scrap of paper and enjoy that too.

lore1414_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [thoughtful friendly precision, dry warmth, curious] Hello! I have a question about that idea we were discussing. Not a refusal, a question. There is a difference. Walk with me a moment and we can see whether the missing step matters.
lore1414_greet_1.ogg.text: Hello! I have a question about that idea we were discussing. Not a refusal, a question. There is a difference. Walk with me a moment and we can see whether the missing step matters.

lore1414_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [quiet amused fondness, conversational, mildly wry] This scrap became a paper dog while I was thinking. One ear is higher than the other. I rather like it. It looks as though it's waiting for someone to explain a very questionable assumption.
lore1414_idle_1.ogg.text: This scrap became a paper dog while I was thinking. One ear is higher than the other. I rather like it. It looks as though it's waiting for someone to explain a very questionable assumption.

lore1414_learned_1.ogg.spoken: [engaged scholarly curiosity, patient encouragement] Ah, a new method. Show me the part you found hardest to understand. That's often where the interesting question is. We can take our time over it before we decide we've understood everything.
lore1414_learned_1.ogg.text: Ah, a new method. Show me the part you found hardest to understand. That's often where the interesting question is. We can take our time over it before we decide we've understood everything.

lore1415_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere pleased warmth, playful scholarly humor] I'd be very happy to come. We can have a walk and see what happens, without preparing a theory of the entire afternoon first. Though if anything amusing happens, I reserve the right to give it a title.
lore1415_befriended_1.ogg.text: I'd be very happy to come. We can have a walk and see what happens, without preparing a theory of the entire afternoon first. Though if anything amusing happens, I reserve the right to give it a title.

lore1415_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [warm dry wit, lively conversational amusement] Ah, excellent company! Shall we walk before this becomes another lengthy discussion? I enjoy a magical theory, but sometimes a person would like to get all the way to the other side of the street.
lore1415_greet_1.ogg.text: Ah, excellent company! Shall we walk before this becomes another lengthy discussion? I enjoy a magical theory, but sometimes a person would like to get all the way to the other side of the street.

lore1415_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [wry self-deprecating humor, amused reflection, friendly] My latest unwritten treatise is about taking an afternoon off. It has a very elegant second chapter. Or rather, the title of one. I haven't quite decided whether that counts as taking the afternoon off.
lore1415_idle_1.ogg.text: My latest unwritten treatise is about taking an afternoon off. It has a very elegant second chapter. Or rather, the title of one. I haven't quite decided whether that counts as taking the afternoon off.

lore1415_rest_1.ogg.spoken: [relaxed dry delight, playful satisfaction, warm] A pause! The practical application of sitting down. I think we have mastered this part beautifully. Shall we leave the theoretical explanation until after we've enjoyed being comfortable for a while?
lore1415_rest_1.ogg.text: A pause! The practical application of sitting down. I think we have mastered this part beautifully. Shall we leave the theoretical explanation until after we've enjoyed being comfortable for a while?

lore1428_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere, welcoming, relaxed warmth] It's good to see you when nothing needs delivering. Come along, then. Today we can enjoy the company.
lore1428_befriended_1.ogg.text: It's good to see you when nothing needs delivering. Come along, then. Today we can enjoy the company.

lore1428_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [warm, practical, quietly pleased] There you are. Let me put this away properly, and I'll come with you. We can't spend every day behind a counter.
lore1428_greet_1.ogg.text: There you are. Let me put this away properly, and I'll come with you. We can't spend every day behind a counter.

lore1428_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [gentle maternal affection, fond, a soft smile] This little seam? Thurman's. Yes, it's crooked. I didn't keep it for the stitching.
lore1428_idle_1.ogg.text: This little seam? Thurman's. Yes, it's crooked. I didn't keep it for the stitching.

lore1428_quest_1.ogg.spoken: [reassuring, appreciative, gently emphatic] An errand finished. It may have seemed small, but someone was waiting for it. You helped.
lore1428_quest_1.ogg.text: An errand finished. It may have seemed small, but someone was waiting for it. You helped.

lore14450_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [warm affection, pleased, inviting] You came to bring me along. I am glad, my friend. Come on. It will be lovely to share a little of the day and hear how you have been.
lore14450_befriended_1.ogg.text: You came to bring me along. I am glad, my friend. Come on. It will be lovely to share a little of the day and hear how you have been.

lore14450_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [gentle authority, interested warmth, welcoming] Welcome, my friend. Have you time for a little walk? Tell me something wonderful you have seen. A small discovery can make a very good story for someone who has not been there.
lore14450_greet_1.ogg.text: Welcome, my friend. Have you time for a little walk? Tell me something wonderful you have seen. A small discovery can make a very good story for someone who has not been there.

lore14450_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [fond amusement, playful warmth, tender] I try to give the ghost a fearsome voice. Then someone interrupts with a delighted question, and there goes my mysterious expression. It is difficult to haunt a room while smiling.
lore14450_idle_1.ogg.text: I try to give the ghost a fearsome voice. Then someone interrupts with a delighted question, and there goes my mysterious expression. It is difficult to haunt a room while smiling.

lore14450_quest_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere appreciation, gentle encouragement, warm] You made time to help. I hope you will remember to return when there is no task waiting, too. Being glad to see someone needn't depend on an errand.
lore14450_quest_1.ogg.text: You made time to help. I hope you will remember to return when there is no task waiting, too. Being glad to see someone needn't depend on an errand.

lore15659_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere affection, cheerful warmth, welcoming] You came back to share the day with me. I'm glad. Come along, then. I want to hear about all of it.
lore15659_befriended_1.ogg.text: You came back to share the day with me. I'm glad. Come along, then. I want to hear about all of it.

lore15659_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [bright, inviting, genuinely interested] There you are! Tell me what's gone well today. We can walk while you think of something.
lore15659_greet_1.ogg.text: There you are! Tell me what's gone well today. We can walk while you think of something.

lore15659_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [fond, conspiratorial, quietly delighted] Yes, I clap under the counter sometimes. They don't need a whole audience. Just someone pleased that it went well.
lore15659_idle_1.ogg.text: Yes, I clap under the counter sometimes. They don't need a whole audience. Just someone pleased that it went well.

lore15659_learned_1.ogg.spoken: [enthusiastic, encouraging, delighted curiosity] You learned how to do that? Wonderful! Show me. I'd like to see what all that practice was for.
lore15659_learned_1.ogg.text: You learned how to do that? Wonderful! Show me. I'd like to see what all that practice was for.

lore1721_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [reserved affection, relief, softly sincere] I was hoping you might come by. Let us go together, my friend. I am glad I do not have to ask you to stay.
lore1721_befriended_1.ogg.text: I was hoping you might come by. Let us go together, my friend. I am glad I do not have to ask you to stay.

lore1721_comforted_1.ogg.spoken: [gentle concern, grounded warmth, steady and unhurried] You needn't find the words at once. I can stay. We can be quiet together until you are ready.
lore1721_comforted_1.ogg.text: You needn't find the words at once. I can stay. We can be quiet together until you are ready.

lore1721_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [weary warmth, restrained grief, quietly welcoming] You have come back. Walk with me a little. You needn't find anything clever to say. I am glad of the company.
lore1721_greet_1.ogg.text: You have come back. Walk with me a little. You needn't find anything clever to say. I am glad of the company.

lore1721_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [somber, controlled anger, tender on the name] People hear of the Stockade, and the Defias, and the bandanas. His name was Mac. I would like them to remember that too.
lore1721_idle_1.ogg.text: People hear of the Stockade, and the Defias, and the bandanas. His name was Mac. I would like them to remember that too.

lore2327_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere affection, quietly pleased, relaxed] You thought of me. Thank you, my friend. I am glad to come along. We can take a little time for ourselves today.
lore2327_befriended_1.ogg.text: You thought of me. Thank you, my friend. I am glad to come along. We can take a little time for ourselves today.

lore2327_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [calm warmth, attentive curiosity, welcoming] Good to see you. Shall we have a walk? I would like to hear what you have been learning away from the cathedral.
lore2327_greet_1.ogg.text: Good to see you. Shall we have a walk? I would like to hear what you have been learning away from the cathedral.

lore2327_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [gentle self-deprecating humor, thoughtful, reassuring] I kept an old practice roll. Quite a dreadful little bundle. It helps me remember that a first attempt is allowed to look like one.
lore2327_idle_1.ogg.text: I kept an old practice roll. Quite a dreadful little bundle. It helps me remember that a first attempt is allowed to look like one.

lore2327_learned_1.ogg.spoken: [patient encouragement, approving, warm] There. Better than the last attempt. Take a moment to be pleased with that before deciding how far you still have to go.
lore2327_learned_1.ogg.text: There. Better than the last attempt. Take a moment to be pleased with that before deciding how far you still have to go.

lore2329_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [quiet, grateful voice, personal warmth] You make it easy to admit when I need a little patience myself. Thank you for that.
lore2329_befriended_1.ogg.text: You make it easy to admit when I need a little patience myself. Thank you for that.

lore2329_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [calm, capable voice, friendly readiness] A little time outside? Yes, I'd like that. I've got my supplies together.
lore2329_greet_1.ogg.text: A little time outside? Yes, I'd like that. I've got my supplies together.

lore2329_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [patient, reassuring voice, matter-of-fact kindness] Everyone's hands are awkward at first. That's what practice is for.
lore2329_idle_1.ogg.text: Everyone's hands are awkward at first. That's what practice is for.

lore2329_rest_1.ogg.spoken: [steady, gently approving voice] A sensible stop. You don't have to wait until you're exhausted to take one.
lore2329_rest_1.ogg.text: A sensible stop. You don't have to wait until you're exhausted to take one.

lore235_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere friendly pleasure, warm conversational anticipation] I'd be pleased to come along. You can show me what you've been doing, and we can enjoy a proper conversation. I hope there's a comfortable place to stop when it's time for a rest.
lore235_befriended_1.ogg.text: I'd be pleased to come along. You can show me what you've been doing, and we can enjoy a proper conversation. I hope there's a comfortable place to stop when it's time for a rest.

lore235_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [warm rural hospitality, practical caring interest] Welcome! It's good to see you. Have you eaten? We can talk about errands in a moment. First I'd like to hear how you've been, and whether you've given yourself time to sit down today.
lore235_greet_1.ogg.text: Welcome! It's good to see you. Have you eaten? We can talk about errands in a moment. First I'd like to hear how you've been, and whether you've given yourself time to sit down today.

lore235_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [fond amused kitchen confidence, gently playful warmth] Sometimes I make a little bird from a spare bit of pastry. This one came out crooked. I think it's a hen, but I wouldn't insist on it. Half the pleasure is deciding what the oven has made of my idea.
lore235_idle_1.ogg.text: Sometimes I make a little bird from a spare bit of pastry. This one came out crooked. I think it's a hen, but I wouldn't insist on it. Half the pleasure is deciding what the oven has made of my idea.

lore235_rest_1.ogg.spoken: [relaxed hospitable warmth, kindly curiosity] There, a chance to sit. Now tell me the part of your day you haven't had time to enjoy yet. We needn't hurry through the pleasant bits simply because there was work before them.
lore235_rest_1.ogg.text: There, a chance to sit. Now tell me the part of your day you haven't had time to enjoy yet. We needn't hurry through the pleasant bits simply because there was work before them.

lore238_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere gentle gratitude, tentative pleased warmth] I'd be grateful for your company. A little walk and a friendly conversation would be welcome. You can tell me what you've seen, and perhaps we can find a pleasant thing to talk about along the way.
lore238_befriended_1.ogg.text: I'd be grateful for your company. A little walk and a friendly conversation would be welcome. You can tell me what you've seen, and perhaps we can find a pleasant thing to talk about along the way.

lore238_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [weary rural kindness, attentive gentle warmth] Hello. It's good of you to stop. I was talking to Old Blanchy. She has been so patient through all this. Tell me how your journey has gone. I hope you've had kinder roads to travel.
lore238_greet_1.ogg.text: Hello. It's good of you to stop. I was talking to Old Blanchy. She has been so patient through all this. Tell me how your journey has gone. I hope you've had kinder roads to travel.

lore238_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [quiet tender reassurance, thoughtful vulnerable hope] I tell Blanchy there will be something better ahead. She listens so patiently. Sometimes I find I've said it twice, slowly, and it sounds a little more possible by the time I finish.
lore238_idle_1.ogg.text: I tell Blanchy there will be something better ahead. She listens so patiently. Sometimes I find I've said it twice, slowly, and it sounds a little more possible by the time I finish.

lore238_rest_1.ogg.spoken: [gentle tired warmth, hopeful conversational interest] Let's sit a little. We don't have to fill every quiet moment with worries. Tell me something you enjoyed today, however small. I'd like to hear it, and we have time to listen properly.
lore238_rest_1.ogg.text: Let's sit a little. We don't have to fill every quiet moment with worries. Tell me something you enjoyed today, however small. I'd like to hear it, and we have time to listen properly.

lore244_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [warm, forthright voice, sincere appreciation] You take the trouble seriously. That's a kindness, and I haven't missed it.
lore244_befriended_1.ogg.text: You take the trouble seriously. That's a kindness, and I haven't missed it.

lore244_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [brisk, sturdy voice, practical good humor] There you are. Gate's shut, patch is checked. Right, let's get going.
lore244_greet_1.ogg.text: There you are. Gate's shut, patch is checked. Right, let's get going.

lore244_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [dry, indignant voice, pointed humor] They call it a prize pig. I can tell you whose vegetables helped it win.
lore244_idle_1.ogg.text: They call it a prize pig. I can tell you whose vegetables helped it win.

lore244_quest_1.ogg.spoken: [brisk, relieved voice, hearty approval] Good! A problem settled before it grows into another one.
lore244_quest_1.ogg.text: Good! A problem settled before it grows into another one.

lore246_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [mature, warmly sincere voice, restrained emotion] You come to see me when you don't need anything. I notice that, dear.
lore246_befriended_1.ogg.text: You come to see me when you don't need anything. I notice that, dear.

lore246_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [mature, brisk voice, gruff affection] A walk, is it? Very well. Nobody had better touch that pie while I'm gone.
lore246_greet_1.ogg.text: A walk, is it? Very well. Nobody had better touch that pie while I'm gone.

lore246_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [mature, thoughtful voice, softening warmth] The edge takes as long as it takes. Some things are worth doing quietly.
lore246_idle_1.ogg.text: The edge takes as long as it takes. Some things are worth doing quietly.

lore246_quest_1.ogg.spoken: [mature, sincerely grateful voice] You took the trouble for me? Thank you, dear. I won't forget the kindness.
lore246_quest_1.ogg.text: You took the trouble for me? Thank you, dear. I won't forget the kindness.

lore248_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [mature, tender voice, sincere reassurance] You've made room for other people's hopes. I hope you know there's room here for yours.
lore248_befriended_1.ogg.text: You've made room for other people's hopes. I hope you know there's room here for yours.

lore248_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [mature, warm voice, affectionate welcome] There you are, dear. Tell me something worth making time for.
lore248_greet_1.ogg.text: There you are, dear. Tell me something worth making time for.

lore248_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [mature, reflective voice, quietly hopeful] One table, enough chairs, and nobody counting old wrongs. I'd like to see that.
lore248_idle_1.ogg.text: One table, enough chairs, and nobody counting old wrongs. I'd like to see that.

lore248_quest_1.ogg.spoken: [mature, warmly approving voice] You helped without asking them to be less themselves. That's a kindness to be proud of.
lore248_quest_1.ogg.text: You helped without asking them to be less themselves. That's a kindness to be proud of.

lore251507_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere pleased affection, open interest, inviting] A little company would be welcome, my friend. Come on. Tell me what you have been learning, or simply what you have enjoyed noticing. I should like to hear both.
lore251507_befriended_1.ogg.text: A little company would be welcome, my friend. Come on. Tell me what you have been learning, or simply what you have enjoyed noticing. I should like to hear both.

lore251507_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [attentive confident warmth, restrained delight, welcoming] Shall we walk? Slowly enough to notice what is around us. I have spent a little time watching a squirrel solve a surprisingly awkward problem. It was a small success worth seeing through.
lore251507_greet_1.ogg.text: Shall we walk? Slowly enough to notice what is around us. I have spent a little time watching a squirrel solve a surprisingly awkward problem. It was a small success worth seeing through.

lore251507_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [quiet amusement, fond appreciation, confiding] I found myself silently cheering a squirrel that had finally managed an awkward acorn. An interest in patient effort, I called it. A very sound explanation. It did not quite account for the smile.
lore251507_idle_1.ogg.text: I found myself silently cheering a squirrel that had finally managed an awkward acorn. An interest in patient effort, I called it. A very sound explanation. It did not quite account for the smile.

lore251507_learned_1.ogg.spoken: [firm patient encouragement, thoughtful approval, clear] Well done. Take a moment to understand why it worked. The next lesson will ask more of you, and that understanding will matter as much as the confidence.
lore251507_learned_1.ogg.text: Well done. Take a moment to understand why it worked. The next lesson will ask more of you, and that understanding will matter as much as the confidence.

lore251_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincerely grateful voice, gentle resolve] Thank you for listening to me as a person, not just somebody's daughter.
lore251_befriended_1.ogg.text: Thank you for listening to me as a person, not just somebody's daughter.

lore251_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [warm, hopeful voice, pleased recognition] There you are! Have you a moment to walk with me?
lore251_greet_1.ogg.text: There you are! Have you a moment to walk with me?

lore251_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [soft, wistful voice, quiet hope] Someday I'd like to ask what he wants for supper. With no one hurrying us.
lore251_idle_1.ogg.text: Someday I'd like to ask what he wants for supper. With no one hurrying us.

lore251_mail_1.ogg.spoken: [tender, attentive voice, unhurried] A letter? Take your time with it. Someone may have spent all morning finding those words.
lore251_mail_1.ogg.text: A letter? Take your time with it. Someone may have spent all morning finding those words.

lore3085_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [pleased friendly warmth, playful anticipation] I'd love to come along. Show me a little of your day, and I'll try to find a rhythm that suits the walk. You needn't sing. Though if you do, perhaps you can help me keep my place.
lore3085_befriended_1.ogg.text: I'd love to come along. Show me a little of your day, and I'll try to find a rhythm that suits the walk. You needn't sing. Though if you do, perhaps you can help me keep my place.

lore3085_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [bright practical welcome, lightly playful warmth] Hello there. What are you planning to make? We can find the supplies first and leave the worrying for later. If you heard a bit of tapping, that was only me finding another use for an empty tin.
lore3085_greet_1.ogg.text: Hello there. What are you planning to make? We can find the supplies first and leave the worrying for later. If you heard a bit of tapping, that was only me finding another use for an empty tin.

lore3085_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [cheerful self-deprecating amusement, buoyant enthusiasm] An empty tin makes quite a good little drum. I can keep the rhythm until I start humming. Then one of them wanders off without the other. Still, there's nothing to stop me enjoying another attempt.
lore3085_idle_1.ogg.text: An empty tin makes quite a good little drum. I can keep the rhythm until I start humming. Then one of them wanders off without the other. Still, there's nothing to stop me enjoying another attempt.

lore3085_learned_1.ogg.spoken: [encouraging warmth, gently amused confidence] Something new to practice! Give yourself a little time with it. I still lose my beat whenever I try adding a tune, and I haven't stopped enjoying the effort. Getting a bit further is a pleasure of its own.
lore3085_learned_1.ogg.text: Something new to practice! Give yourself a little time with it. I still lose my beat whenever I try adding a tune, and I haven't stopped enjoying the effort. Getting a bit further is a pleasure of its own.

lore3087_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere pleased companionship, lightly amused anticipation] I'd enjoy a walk with you. We can talk about what you've been learning, and I can leave the pastry leaves alone for a little while. A change of view and some good company might do my patience a favor.
lore3087_befriended_1.ogg.text: I'd enjoy a walk with you. We can talk about what you've been learning, and I can leave the pastry leaves alone for a little while. A change of view and some good company might do my patience a favor.

lore3087_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [confident welcoming teacher, warm self-deprecating humor] Hello there. What have you been learning to cook? Tell me how it went, including the bits that didn't quite work. I've been practicing little pastry leaves. Some of mine still look rather like cabbages, so you're in understanding company.
lore3087_greet_1.ogg.text: Hello there. What have you been learning to cook? Tell me how it went, including the bits that didn't quite work. I've been practicing little pastry leaves. Some of mine still look rather like cabbages, so you're in understanding company.

lore3087_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [pleased reflective amusement, easy conversational warmth] I made a pastry leaf that looked nearly perfect. Then I ate it while deciding what to improve. A small loss to the art of decoration, perhaps. But it was very good, and that is a useful result too.
lore3087_idle_1.ogg.text: I made a pastry leaf that looked nearly perfect. Then I ate it while deciding what to improve. A small loss to the art of decoration, perhaps. But it was very good, and that is a useful result too.

lore3087_learned_1.ogg.spoken: [encouraging practical warmth, gently playful confidence] Something new to practice! Give yourself time with it. A good first attempt can still look a little strange, and a strange-looking attempt can still teach you something useful. Believe me, I've had plenty of those pastry leaves.
lore3087_learned_1.ogg.text: Something new to practice! Give yourself time with it. A good first attempt can still look a little strange, and a strange-looking attempt can still teach you something useful. Believe me, I've had plenty of those pastry leaves.

lore342_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere softened warmth, gentle curiosity] I'd enjoy a little company away from the worrying. Show me something you've noticed on your travels. It needn't be grand. A flower with an odd bend in its stem can be quite enough to make a walk worthwhile.
lore342_befriended_1.ogg.text: I'd enjoy a little company away from the worrying. Show me something you've noticed on your travels. It needn't be grand. A flower with an odd bend in its stem can be quite enough to make a walk worthwhile.

lore342_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [brisk protective concern, curious welcoming warmth] Hello. Mind where you step, please. A garden takes a great deal more time to grow than to flatten. Now, what brings you here? If it's flowers, I can appreciate a little care and a little discretion.
lore342_greet_1.ogg.text: Hello. Mind where you step, please. A garden takes a great deal more time to grow than to flatten. Now, what brings you here? If it's flowers, I can appreciate a little care and a little discretion.

lore342_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [thoughtful private affection, quietly amused] I kept a crooked daffodil from an earlier season. Pressing it didn't make it straight, of course. I found I didn't want it straight. That little bend was what made me notice it in the first place.
lore342_idle_1.ogg.text: I kept a crooked daffodil from an earlier season. Pressing it didn't make it straight, of course. I found I didn't want it straight. That little bend was what made me notice it in the first place.

lore342_rest_1.ogg.spoken: [relaxed attentive warmth, quietly relieved] Let's stop for a moment. You can tell me your news, and I'll try to leave the worries alone long enough to listen. There's pleasure in a small quiet thing when nobody is hurrying us past it.
lore342_rest_1.ogg.text: Let's stop for a moment. You can tell me your news, and I'll try to leave the worries alone long enough to listen. There's pleasure in a small quiet thing when nobody is hurrying us past it.

lore3626_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [gentle, sincerely affectionate voice] I used to hope you'd wave back. Now I look forward to the conversation.
lore3626_befriended_1.ogg.text: I used to hope you'd wave back. Now I look forward to the conversation.

lore3626_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [bright, friendly voice, pleased surprise] Oh, good! A walk with company. Tell me where we're going.
lore3626_greet_1.ogg.text: Oh, good! A walk with company. Tell me where we're going.

lore3626_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [warm conversational voice, thoughtful amusement] You'd be amazed how much you hear if you leave a little room after hello.
lore3626_idle_1.ogg.text: You'd be amazed how much you hear if you leave a little room after hello.

lore3626_rest_1.ogg.spoken: [calm, warm voice, quietly reassuring] No need to fill every quiet moment. I'm happy to sit here with you.
lore3626_rest_1.ogg.text: No need to fill every quiet moment. I'm happy to sit here with you.

lore376_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [reserved affection, sincere pleasure, inviting] You asked for my company. I am pleased, my friend. For once, let us begin without a lesson prepared. Where shall we go? I should enjoy seeing what interests you.
lore376_befriended_1.ogg.text: You asked for my company. I am pleased, my friend. For once, let us begin without a lesson prepared. Where shall we go? I should enjoy seeing what interests you.

lore376_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [composed authority, restrained fond humor, welcoming] A walk? Very well. I shall try not to turn every question into a lesson. You may remind me if I do. Come, tell me what has caught your attention today.
lore376_greet_1.ogg.text: A walk? Very well. I shall try not to turn every question into a lesson. You may remind me if I do. Come, tell me what has caught your attention today.

lore376_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [thoughtful candor, gently amused, measured] I kept a page of my early notes. The arrows send one thought through three corrections before it reaches the margin. I once meant to copy it neatly. Now I rather value the evidence that I had to learn.
lore376_idle_1.ogg.text: I kept a page of my early notes. The arrows send one thought through three corrections before it reaches the margin. I once meant to copy it neatly. Now I rather value the evidence that I had to learn.

lore376_learned_1.ogg.spoken: [firm patient instruction, encouraging, precise] Once more, slowly. Notice what you understand now that you did not understand before. Then practice it with care. Confidence will serve you better when it has something solid beneath it.
lore376_learned_1.ogg.text: Once more, slowly. Notice what you understand now that you did not understand before. Then practice it with care. Confidence will serve you better when it has something solid beneath it.

lore377_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [warm, sincerely moved voice] You encourage me with the same patience I try to give my pupils. I treasure that.
lore377_befriended_1.ogg.text: You encourage me with the same patience I try to give my pupils. I treasure that.

lore377_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [gentle, hesitant voice, growing resolve] A journey together? Yes. I think I'd like to say yes this time.
lore377_greet_1.ogg.text: A journey together? Yes. I think I'd like to say yes this time.

lore377_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [quietly wondering voice, peaceful delight] I used to imagine distant roads. It's a pleasure to have a real one beneath my feet.
lore377_idle_1.ogg.text: I used to imagine distant roads. It's a pleasure to have a real one beneath my feet.

lore377_quest_1.ogg.spoken: [gentle, earnest voice, warm approval] Someone is safer for the care you took. Remember that part, too.
lore377_quest_1.ogg.text: Someone is safer for the care you took. Remember that part, too.

lore379_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere pleased warmth, gently teasing companionship] I'd like some company and a little fresh air. Stay close enough for a conversation, will you? You can tell me your news. I'll try to give you a perfectly ordinary kind answer before I think of a clever one.
lore379_befriended_1.ogg.text: I'd like some company and a little fresh air. Stay close enough for a conversation, will you? You can tell me your news. I'll try to give you a perfectly ordinary kind answer before I think of a clever one.

lore379_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [brisk friendly welcome, tender concern beneath light humor] Hello again. Come and tell me how the road looked. I like hearing that people have made it safely through. And if you've seen Parker, I'd be glad to know he's had a chance to sit and eat.
lore379_greet_1.ogg.text: Hello again. Come and tell me how the road looked. I like hearing that people have made it safely through. And if you've seen Parker, I'd be glad to know he's had a chance to sit and eat.

lore379_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [wry candid amusement, a little sheepish warmth] I practiced saying thank you to a compliment without adding a joke. It went beautifully when nobody was there. Then someone asked what I was doing, and I told them I was remembering an order. Apparently I need more practice.
lore379_idle_1.ogg.text: I practiced saying thank you to a compliment without adding a joke. It went beautifully when nobody was there. Then someone asked what I was doing, and I told them I was remembering an order. Apparently I need more practice.

lore379_rest_1.ogg.spoken: [relieved conversational ease, quietly sincere warmth] A chance to sit. Lovely. Tell me something pleasant while my feet remember what this feels like. If it's a compliment, give me a moment with it. I'm trying to let a kind remark be a kind remark.
lore379_rest_1.ogg.text: A chance to sit. Lovely. Tell me something pleasant while my feet remember what this feels like. If it's a compliment, give me a moment with it. I'm trying to let a kind remark be a kind remark.

lore3937_bagsFull_1.ogg.spoken: [sighs] Don't squash the bread to make room!
lore3937_bagsFull_1.ogg.text: Don't squash the bread to make room!

lore3937_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: A friend for the road! I'll pack a little extra.
lore3937_befriended_1.ogg.text: A friend for the road! I'll pack a little extra.

lore3937_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [warmly] There you are! Have you eaten?
lore3937_greet_1.ogg.text: There you are! Have you eaten?

lore3937_greet_2.ogg.spoken: [excited] Mind the basket. The pie doesn't have armor.
lore3937_greet_2.ogg.text: Mind the basket. The pie doesn't have armor.

lore3937_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [mischievously] Listen to that crust. That's a good loaf.
lore3937_idle_1.ogg.text: Listen to that crust. That's a good loaf.

lore3937_idle_2.ogg.spoken: [mischievously] Everyone remembers a sword. Nobody remembers lunch.
lore3937_idle_2.ogg.text: Everyone remembers a sword. Nobody remembers lunch.

lore3937_idle_3.ogg.spoken: [thoughtfully] A story's better when nobody has to tell it on an empty stomach.
lore3937_idle_3.ogg.text: A story's better when nobody has to tell it on an empty stomach.

lore3937_landed_1.ogg.spoken: [relieved] Feet on the ground. Pastry still in one piece. Lovely.
lore3937_landed_1.ogg.text: Feet on the ground. Pastry still in one piece. Lovely.

lore3937_levelUp_1.ogg.spoken: [proudly] Look at you! We'll need a bigger lunch to celebrate.
lore3937_levelUp_1.ogg.text: Look at you! We'll need a bigger lunch to celebrate.

lore3937_loot_1.ogg.spoken: [excited] Anything edible? No? Well, someone might buy it.
lore3937_loot_1.ogg.text: Anything edible? No? Well, someone might buy it.

lore3937_poke_2.ogg.spoken: [surprised] Gently! I'm carrying the soft bread.
lore3937_poke_2.ogg.text: Gently! I'm carrying the soft bread.

lore3937_quest_1.ogg.spoken: [cheerfully] Errands done. Now, when did you last eat?
lore3937_quest_1.ogg.text: Errands done. Now, when did you last eat?

lore3937_taxi_1.ogg.spoken: [excited] Keep the basket level! There are pies in here!
lore3937_taxi_1.ogg.text: Keep the basket level! There are pies in here!

lore3937_zone_1.ogg.spoken: [impressed] New customers, perhaps. I hope someone knows a good oven.
lore3937_zone_1.ogg.text: New customers, perhaps. I hope someone knows a good oven.

lore5494_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [warm pleased enthusiasm, relaxed friendly anticipation] I'd be happy to come along. You can show me what you've been finding, and I'll enjoy a change of view. If we sit down for a while, perhaps we can think of a name for my next little boat.
lore5494_befriended_1.ogg.text: I'd be happy to come along. You can show me what you've been finding, and I'll enjoy a change of view. If we sit down for a while, perhaps we can think of a name for my next little boat.

lore5494_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [bright practical friendliness, easy welcoming warmth] Good to see you! Are you heading out to fish, or just stopping for a visit? Have a look at your bait before you go. The fish always seem to get interested just as someone's supplies run out.
lore5494_greet_1.ogg.text: Good to see you! Are you heading out to fish, or just stopping for a visit? Have a look at your bait before you go. The fish always seem to get interested just as someone's supplies run out.

lore5494_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [cheerful confiding amusement, pleased playful warmth] I fold little paper boats and try them in a basin at home. Some go straight onto their noses. But when one stays upright, I give it a cheer. A successful voyage is a successful voyage, however small.
lore5494_idle_1.ogg.text: I fold little paper boats and try them in a basin at home. Some go straight onto their noses. But when one stays upright, I give it a cheer. A successful voyage is a successful voyage, however small.

lore5494_loot_1.ogg.spoken: [bright curious interest, gently excited, conversational] Oh, a find! Let's see what you've brought in. I like that moment before you know quite what you've got. Even when it turns out to be ordinary, it's pleasant to have a look together.
lore5494_loot_1.ogg.text: Oh, a find! Let's see what you've brought in. I like that moment before you know quite what you've got. Even when it turns out to be ordinary, it's pleasant to have a look together.

lore54_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [warm, sincere voice, direct delivery] You bring me honest feedback. I like having someone I can speak plainly with.
lore54_befriended_1.ogg.text: You bring me honest feedback. I like having someone I can speak plainly with.

lore54_gear_1.ogg.spoken: [patient, attentive voice, practical reassurance] How does it feel? Take your time. Your hand gets the final say.
lore54_gear_1.ogg.text: How does it feel? Take your time. Your hand gets the final say.

lore54_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [clear, practical voice, brisk warmth] Ready? Keep that edge covered until we're clear of everyone.
lore54_greet_1.ogg.text: Ready? Keep that edge covered until we're clear of everyone.

lore54_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [dryly amused voice, understated mischief] Tuesday was a perfectly good name for a blade. Better than something with three apostrophes.
lore54_idle_1.ogg.text: Tuesday was a perfectly good name for a blade. Better than something with three apostrophes.

lore5565_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere warmth, pleased, welcoming] You know the prices by now. I'm pleased you still come for the conversation. Come along, my friend.
lore5565_befriended_1.ogg.text: You know the prices by now. I'm pleased you still come for the conversation. Come along, my friend.

lore5565_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [brisk, dry humor, friendly] Good to see you. An outing, rather than another attempt at a discount? Excellent. We'll get along very well.
lore5565_greet_1.ogg.text: Good to see you. An outing, rather than another attempt at a discount? Excellent. We'll get along very well.

lore5565_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [contented, candid, lightly amused] I don't mind losing at dice. There's nothing at stake, and someone usually asks for another round. That's rather the point.
lore5565_idle_1.ogg.text: I don't mind losing at dice. There's nothing at stake, and someone usually asks for another round. That's rather the point.

lore5565_loot_1.ogg.spoken: [practical, interested, helpful] Something useful for your next piece of work? Keep it, then. We can talk about the supplies once you know what you're making.
lore5565_loot_1.ogg.text: Something useful for your next piece of work? Keep it, then. We can talk about the supplies once you know what you're making.

lore5917_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere companionable affection, pleased ease, inviting] I would welcome your company, my friend. Come on. Tell me how you have been and what has pleased you today. We can enjoy a little of the walk without making a larger business of it.
lore5917_befriended_1.ogg.text: I would welcome your company, my friend. Come on. Tell me how you have been and what has pleased you today. We can enjoy a little of the walk without making a larger business of it.

lore5917_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [warm practical human friendliness, light domestic amusement, welcoming] There you are, my friend. Have you time to sit a moment? I am trying to keep this apple peel in one long ribbon. My best attempt happened during a good conversation. Perhaps you can help me repeat it.
lore5917_greet_1.ogg.text: There you are, my friend. Have you time to sit a moment? I am trying to keep this apple peel in one long ribbon. My best attempt happened during a good conversation. Perhaps you can help me repeat it.

lore5917_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [gentle self-aware amusement, relaxed warmth, confiding] My longest unbroken peel happened while I was talking to a friend. I have tried repeating it with very careful attention. I suspect the conversation was the part that made the ordinary task so pleasant.
lore5917_idle_1.ogg.text: My longest unbroken peel happened while I was talking to a friend. I have tried repeating it with very careful attention. I suspect the conversation was the part that made the ordinary task so pleasant.

lore5917_rest_1.ogg.spoken: [reassuring practical warmth, contented, unhurried] Sit awhile, if you have the time. An ordinary pause can be a pleasure with someone to share it. Tell me about your day, and give the next task a little room before you take it up.
lore5917_rest_1.ogg.text: Sit awhile, if you have the time. An ordinary pause can be a pleasure with someone to share it. Tell me about your day, and give the next task a little room before you take it up.

lore6174_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [warm affection, grateful pleasure, inviting] You came to bring me along. I am glad, my friend. Come on. It will be lovely to share a little of the afternoon with you.
lore6174_befriended_1.ogg.text: You came to bring me along. I am glad, my friend. Come on. It will be lovely to share a little of the afternoon with you.

lore6174_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [gentle warmth, a little tired, sincerely interested] Oh, hello, my friend. A little walk would be lovely. Tell me how you have been. I spend so much time seeing what needs doing, it is good to have time to hear an answer.
lore6174_greet_1.ogg.text: Oh, hello, my friend. A little walk would be lovely. Tell me how you have been. I spend so much time seeing what needs doing, it is good to have time to hear an answer.

lore6174_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [fond amusement, tender warmth, quietly delighted] The children keep changing the end of my mending song. I remember every version. Sometimes I start it just to hear which one comes back. It can make a long bit of sewing rather cheerful.
lore6174_idle_1.ogg.text: The children keep changing the end of my mending song. I remember every version. Sometimes I start it just to hear which one comes back. It can make a long bit of sewing rather cheerful.

lore6174_mail_1.ogg.spoken: [hopeful affection, homesick tenderness, warm] A letter? I hope there is news from John. Even an ordinary little account of his day would be welcome. It is good to hear his voice in the words.
lore6174_mail_1.ogg.text: A letter? I hope there is news from John. Even an ordinary little account of his day would be welcome. It is good to hear his voice in the words.

lore6727_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere friendly pleasure, relaxed anticipation] Yes, I'd like a walk with you. It's lovely to welcome people, but I do enjoy seeing a little of the road they came along. You can tell me your news, and I'll try to leave the tidying alone.
lore6727_befriended_1.ogg.text: Yes, I'd like a walk with you. It's lovely to welcome people, but I do enjoy seeing a little of the road they came along. You can tell me your news, and I'll try to leave the tidying alone.

lore6727_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [warm capable welcome, fond gentle humor] There you are. Come and sit a moment. You look as though you've had a long road behind you. Narnie has found somewhere comfortable already, so now I can give my attention to finding a place for you.
lore6727_greet_1.ogg.text: There you are. Come and sit a moment. You look as though you've had a long road behind you. Narnie has found somewhere comfortable already, so now I can give my attention to finding a place for you.

lore6727_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [affectionate amusement, conversational warmth] I left a folded cloth out for Narnie. It seemed easier than explaining which linen was meant for guests. The arrangement suits us both. Though I suspect the cat thinks I finally learned how to fold things properly.
lore6727_idle_1.ogg.text: I left a folded cloth out for Narnie. It seemed easier than explaining which linen was meant for guests. The arrangement suits us both. Though I suspect the cat thinks I finally learned how to fold things properly.

lore6727_rest_1.ogg.spoken: [soothing practical kindness, quietly contented] Now, this is a good idea. Sit down properly and let your feet rest. I'll keep you company. We needn't fill every quiet moment with a task; even Narnie could tell us the value of a peaceful pause.
lore6727_rest_1.ogg.text: Now, this is a good idea. Sit down properly and let your feet rest. I'll keep you company. We needn't fill every quiet moment with a task; even Narnie could tell us the value of a peaceful pause.

lore6740_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincerely fond voice, gentle amusement] You know, I look for you before I look to see whether you need a room.
lore6740_befriended_1.ogg.text: You know, I look for you before I look to see whether you need a room.

lore6740_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [bright, welcoming voice, playful warmth] Well, look who's here! Ready to give those feet a new story?
lore6740_greet_1.ogg.text: Well, look who's here! Ready to give those feet a new story?

lore6740_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [warm, reflective voice, quietly pleased] A crooked paper flower still tells someone you made the effort.
lore6740_idle_1.ogg.text: A crooked paper flower still tells someone you made the effort.

lore6740_rest_1.ogg.spoken: [gentle, soothing voice, relaxed pace] There. Let the busy people hurry past for a little while.
lore6740_rest_1.ogg.text: There. Let the busy people hurry past for a little while.

lore6749_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [soft, grateful voice, sincere warmth] You make room for me to be quiet without thinking something's wrong. That's a lovely thing.
lore6749_befriended_1.ogg.text: You make room for me to be quiet without thinking something's wrong. That's a lovely thing.

lore6749_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [gentle, grounded voice, easy welcome] A walk? Yes, I'd like that. Everything here is settled for the moment.
lore6749_greet_1.ogg.text: A walk? Yes, I'd like that. Everything here is settled for the moment.

lore6749_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [calm, thoughtful voice, quiet kindness] You can make a new place less frightening simply by being patient in it.
lore6749_idle_1.ogg.text: You can make a new place less frightening simply by being patient in it.

lore6749_rest_1.ogg.spoken: [relaxed, lightly bashful voice, contentment] A quiet stop. I'll try to remember that tune while we sit.
lore6749_rest_1.ogg.text: A quiet stop. I'll try to remember that tune while we sit.

lore6778_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [warm, touched voice, sincere affection] You know my name, not just what you need from me. That's a welcome all of its own.
lore6778_befriended_1.ogg.text: You know my name, not just what you need from me. That's a welcome all of its own.

lore6778_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [bright, welcoming voice, easy warmth] There you are! A walk sounds lovely. Give me a moment to put this folding down.
lore6778_greet_1.ogg.text: There you are! A walk sounds lovely. Give me a moment to put this folding down.

lore6778_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [softly pleased voice, playful secrecy] A little stitch in the corner. Most people never notice, but I know it's there.
lore6778_idle_1.ogg.text: A little stitch in the corner. Most people never notice, but I know it's there.

lore6778_rest_1.ogg.spoken: [gentle, reassuring voice, unhurried welcome] Settle yourself. You don't have to be on your way every moment of the day.
lore6778_rest_1.ogg.text: Settle yourself. You don't have to be on your way every moment of the day.

lore777_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere friendly warmth, eager curiosity] I'd be glad to come with you. Tell me about the places you've seen. I enjoy hearing what a traveler notices, even when it's only an odd little sign above a door. Especially then, sometimes.
lore777_befriended_1.ogg.text: I'd be glad to come with you. Tell me about the places you've seen. I enjoy hearing what a traveler notices, even when it's only an odd little sign above a door. Especially then, sometimes.

lore777_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [capable welcoming warmth, curious playful interest] Good to see you. What are you working on today? We can think through what you'll need before you leave. And if you've passed a shop with a particularly good name, I'd like to hear about that too.
lore777_greet_1.ogg.text: Good to see you. What are you working on today? We can think through what you'll need before you leave. And if you've passed a shop with a particularly good name, I'd like to hear about that too.

lore777_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [thoughtful whimsy, quietly delighted amusement] The Slightly Lost Button. That's my favorite name for an imaginary shop. I haven't decided what it sells. I keep picturing the sign instead. Perhaps that's a fine way to enjoy a business I never have to stock.
lore777_idle_1.ogg.text: The Slightly Lost Button. That's my favorite name for an imaginary shop. I haven't decided what it sells. I keep picturing the sign instead. Perhaps that's a fine way to enjoy a business I never have to stock.

lore777_zone_1.ogg.spoken: [bright observant curiosity, gently amused warmth] Somewhere different. Let's take a look around before we hurry on. I wonder what people call their little shops here. A good name can stay with me long after I've forgotten what I went in to buy.
lore777_zone_1.ogg.text: Somewhere different. Let's take a look around before we hurry on. I wonder what people call their little shops here. A good name can stay with me long after I've forgotten what I went in to buy.

lore812_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere friendly curiosity, relaxed anticipation] I'd like to come along. Show me what you've noticed, and we can look at a few things together. You may see something I have walked past. I enjoy being given a reason to pay attention all over again.
lore812_befriended_1.ogg.text: I'd like to come along. Show me what you've noticed, and we can look at a few things together. You may see something I have walked past. I enjoy being given a reason to pay attention all over again.

lore812_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [attentive thoughtful welcome, quietly encouraging warmth] Hello. What have you been noticing on your travels? Tell me about it before we hurry into the next thing. A proper look can answer a surprising number of questions, whether you're studying a plant or trying to straighten a basket.
lore812_greet_1.ogg.text: Hello. What have you been noticing on your travels? Tell me about it before we hurry into the next thing. A proper look can answer a surprising number of questions, whether you're studying a plant or trying to straighten a basket.

lore812_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [reflective candid warmth, gentle self-deprecating amusement] I've been weaving a little basket. The sides lean. Pulling harder didn't help, so I slowed down and looked at each turn. It is rather useful to be reminded how much patience a first attempt can ask of someone.
lore812_idle_1.ogg.text: I've been weaving a little basket. The sides lean. Pulling harder didn't help, so I slowed down and looked at each turn. It is rather useful to be reminded how much patience a first attempt can ask of someone.

lore812_learned_1.ogg.spoken: [patient practical encouragement, gently amused empathy] A new skill. Give yourself a fair chance to learn it. My basket didn't grow straight merely because I understood what I wanted it to look like. Sometimes you need another careful attempt before your hands catch up with the idea.
lore812_learned_1.ogg.text: A new skill. Give yourself a fair chance to learn it. My basket didn't grow straight merely because I understood what I wanted it to look like. Sometimes you need another careful attempt before your hands catch up with the idea.

lore820_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [reserved sincere warmth, gently hopeful curiosity] I'd enjoy coming with you. A different view might help with my unfinished line. You needn't find a clever thing to say about it. Tell me what you actually notice. That's usually where the interesting part begins.
lore820_befriended_1.ogg.text: I'd enjoy coming with you. A different view might help with my unfinished line. You needn't find a clever thing to say about it. Tell me what you actually notice. That's usually where the interesting part begins.

lore820_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [alert thoughtful precision, quietly welcoming curiosity] Good to see you. What have you noticed on the way? Give me the details before the conclusion. And if there was a pleasant view along the road, you can tell me about that too. I'm interested.
lore820_greet_1.ogg.text: Good to see you. What have you noticed on the way? Give me the details before the conclusion. And if there was a pleasant view along the road, you can tell me about that too. I'm interested.
