lore820_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [quiet confiding amusement, reflective creative interest] I've been trying to describe the evening light in a few lines. The first attempt sounded like a patrol report. I left one line unfinished. Now I like looking again and finding another word that might belong there.
lore820_idle_1.ogg.text: I've been trying to describe the evening light in a few lines. The first attempt sounded like a patrol report. I left one line unfinished. Now I like looking again and finding another word that might belong there.

lore820_zone_1.ogg.spoken: [observant appreciative wonder, thoughtful inviting warmth] A new view. Give it a moment before we name everything. Look at where the light falls first. I wonder whether you'd describe it the same way I would. Tell me what catches your eye.
lore820_zone_1.ogg.text: A new view. Give it a moment before we name everything. Look at where the light falls first. I wonder whether you'd describe it the same way I would. Tell me what catches your eye.

lore843_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere relaxed warmth, friendly anticipation] I'd enjoy coming with you. Tell me what you've been doing while we walk. We don't have to turn the whole conversation into a list of things that need solving. A pleasant outing is useful in its own way.
lore843_befriended_1.ogg.text: I'd enjoy coming with you. Tell me what you've been doing while we walk. We don't have to turn the whole conversation into a list of things that need solving. A pleasant outing is useful in its own way.

lore843_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [practical friendly attentiveness, quietly amused curiosity] Good to see you. What are you working on today? Tell me the job before we choose the supplies. Or, if you've only come to visit, you can help me look at a particularly determined bit of string.
lore843_greet_1.ogg.text: Good to see you. What are you working on today? Tell me the job before we choose the supplies. Or, if you've only come to visit, you can help me look at a particularly determined bit of string.

lore843_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [patient absorbed amusement, warm confiding interest] I sometimes tie a little tangle just to undo it later. That sounds like making work, doesn't it? But there's no hurry with this one. Find a loose loop, turn it gently, and suddenly the next bit makes sense.
lore843_idle_1.ogg.text: I sometimes tie a little tangle just to undo it later. That sounds like making work, doesn't it? But there's no hurry with this one. Find a loose loop, turn it gently, and suddenly the next bit makes sense.

lore843_loot_1.ogg.spoken: [thoughtful practical curiosity, warmly engaged] What have you found? Let's look at it properly before deciding what it's for. Sometimes one small detail makes the whole thing clearer. Then again, sometimes it is simply pleasant to see something new together.
lore843_loot_1.ogg.text: What have you found? Let's look at it properly before deciding what it's for. Sometimes one small detail makes the whole thing clearer. Then again, sometimes it is simply pleasant to see something new together.

lore8931_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere warm pleasure, easy friendly anticipation] I'd be happy to join you. You can show me the little things you notice between your errands. We needn't make the whole walk into an adventure. A pleasant view and good company will suit me very well.
lore8931_befriended_1.ogg.text: I'd be happy to join you. You can show me the little things you notice between your errands. We needn't make the whole walk into an adventure. A pleasant view and good company will suit me very well.

lore8931_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [warm innkeeper's welcome, relaxed attentive curiosity] Welcome back! Take a moment to catch your breath. Then tell me where you've been. You can start with an ordinary bit of the journey if you like. I enjoy hearing what a place is like when nobody is rushing.
lore8931_greet_1.ogg.text: Welcome back! Take a moment to catch your breath. Then tell me where you've been. You can start with an ordinary bit of the journey if you like. I enjoy hearing what a place is like when nobody is rushing.

lore8931_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [thoughtful pleasant anticipation, quietly delighted warmth] I'd like to visit Ironforge with time to look around. No urgent message, no hurried appointment. Just a chance to watch the city going about its day. Travelers tell such interesting little things when you ask what they noticed.
lore8931_idle_1.ogg.text: I'd like to visit Ironforge with time to look around. No urgent message, no hurried appointment. Just a chance to watch the city going about its day. Travelers tell such interesting little things when you ask what they noticed.

lore8931_rest_1.ogg.spoken: [relaxed hospitable interest, imaginative warm curiosity] A chance to sit! Now, tell me about an ordinary place you liked. A street or a shop will do. I want to imagine it properly, with time to hear the sounds and see who comes past.
lore8931_rest_1.ogg.text: A chance to sit! Now, tell me about an ordinary place you liked. A street or a shop will do. I want to imagine it properly, with time to hear the sounds and see who comes past.

lore913_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [firm, sincere voice, earned respect] I trust you to listen, and to tell me when I'm wrong. That's worth having beside me.
lore913_befriended_1.ogg.text: I trust you to listen, and to tell me when I'm wrong. That's worth having beside me.

lore913_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [firm, confident voice, brisk readiness] Ready? Good. Check your footing, and let's see where the road takes us.
lore913_greet_1.ogg.text: Ready? Good. Check your footing, and let's see where the road takes us.

lore913_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [direct, measured voice, dry authority] A mistake you notice can teach you something. A mistake you blame on luck tends to return.
lore913_idle_1.ogg.text: A mistake you notice can teach you something. A mistake you blame on luck tends to return.

lore913_quest_1.ogg.spoken: [brisk, approving voice, restrained pride] Good work. Remember what helped, and practice what didn't.
lore913_quest_1.ogg.text: Good work. Remember what helped, and practice what didn't.

npc_alive_2.ogg.spoken: [relieved] There you are. Gave me a fright.
npc_alive_2.ogg.text: There you are. Gave me a fright.
